# Draft:Charitra Maheshwari

Charitra Maheshwari is the Managing Director of Siddhika Coatings Limited - only paint contract company in India to be listed on stock exchange (NSE EMERGE).
Career
He started his professional career in 1993 working in family business for 7 years before starting a venture of paint services in construction industry. With 20+ years of experience in paint service industry lead the organization being a public limited company.
Early life and education
Charitra was born on 30th December 1975 in UP, India.
Education and Additional Qualifications
Maryland State University - PhD in Business Management
CSJM University - Bachelor of Arts
Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs - Certified Independent Director
Positions Held Currently
Director - SCL Contracts Pvt. Ltd.
Director - AB Coatings Pvt. Ltd.
Director - Siddhika Consulting & Investment Pvt. Ltd.
Director - Siddhika Business Application Ltd.
Director - Siddhika Foundation
Achievements
* Siddhika Coatings became a public limited company, significant achievement for a paint contract company.
* Siddhika Coatings got listed on NSE Emerge, being the first ever paint contractor in India to get listed on stock exchange.
* Siddhika Coatings was awarded the “Most innovative Company for Construction & Renovation Services - 2023”.
* Siddhika Coatings was awarded for “Service Excellence in Texture Paint 2024”.
